$comment: Derived from zipnative docs/assets/api.json (1.0.0). One row per export of the two entry points; docs/KNOWLEDGE_BASE.md section 8 maps every name to a CLI touchpoint and tests/docs/consistency.test.ts enforces it. kind is derived from the export signature. reach grades the row per the 1.0.0 coverage audit: "capability" = the behaviour behind the export is exercisable from a command, "type" = re-exported (or aliased) for typing only; via names the touchpoint.

exports.name: AddEntryOptions
exports.via: create/modify per-entry compression, date, comment, externalAttributes (mode bits via --preserve-mode / manifest mode), extraFields (manifest extraFields on create entries and modify add/replace/add-dir edits)

exports.name: ByteSource
exports.via: readableToByteSource() — stream input, create --stream file sources, create --stdin-name

exports.name: CodecCompressOptions
exports.via: { level, deterministic } handed to compressSync of a --codec module registering method 0/8 (the writer only emits those methods)

exports.name: CreateZipOptions
exports.via: create: order (insertion = argv/manifest order), defaultDate (UTC wall-clock), compression, comment, strict, onDiagnostic, limits

exports.name: DEFAULT_ZIP_LIMITS
exports.via: --help defaults, doctor limits, schema limits/manifest, inflate default --max-output

exports.name: DeflateTier
exports.via: tier enum in schema status (create/modify/inflate envelopes, doctor)

exports.name: EntryVerification
exports.via: verify rows, verify --entry rows, modify survivor verification (verified/verifySkipped)

exports.name: ExtractOptions
exports.via: extract: rejectTraversal (--skip-unsafe), rejectSymlinks, onDuplicate, filter (--include/--exclude/--entry/--skip-unsupported), limits

exports.name: ExtractedEntry
exports.via: extract --buffered items

exports.name: ExtractedStreamEntry
exports.via: extract items (plan defers stream())

exports.name: FLAG_DATA_DESCRIPTOR
exports.via: decodeFlags() --long rows, forward usesDataDescriptor / descriptorEntries

exports.name: FLAG_ENCRYPTED
exports.via: decodeFlags() --long rows

exports.name: FLAG_STRONG_ENCRYPTION
exports.via: decodeFlags() --long rows

exports.name: FLAG_UTF8
exports.via: decodeFlags() --long rows, inspect UTF-8 verdict

exports.name: Inflator
exports.via: inflate: push/finished/leftover/bytesConsumed/end (bytesConsumed reported in the envelope)

exports.name: IterateZipOptions
exports.via: commonOptions(args, sink) for stream (--strict, --max-*, diagnostics)

exports.name: METHOD_DEFLATE
exports.via: methodName(), inspect --check, inflate --method, extract --skip-unsupported, doctor

exports.name: METHOD_STORE
exports.via: methodName(), inspect --check, inflate --method store, extract --skip-unsupported, doctor

exports.name: OpenZipOptions
exports.via: list --validate; eager forced by inspect, modify, verify --entry

exports.name: ReadEntryOptions
exports.via: cat --no-verify-crc

exports.name: StreamOptions
exports.via: create --chunk-size with --stream or --stdin-name (clamp warned)

exports.name: StreamedZipEntry
exports.via: stream: header/data()/skip() per local entry (custom-method entries cannot be pumped — engine limitation)

exports.name: StreamedZipHeader
exports.via: rowFromHeader() forward EntryRow incl. rawNameHex under --long; descriptor headers carry zero sizes

exports.name: VERSION
exports.via: doctor zipnative check; pins docs/data/*.json in the consistency test

exports.name: VerifiedEntry
exports.via: verify rows (skipped: encrypted | stream-only-codec)

exports.name: VerifyZipOptions
exports.via: verify / batch --task verify { limits }

exports.name: ZipBaseErrorCode
exports.via: the 7 base-code rows of ZIP_TO_CLI (4 reachable; ZIP_API_MISUSE and ZIP_INTERNAL unreachable by design, ZIP_INPUT_TOO_LARGE needs > 2 GiB)

exports.name: ZipCodec
exports.via: --codec module contract (isCodec()), inflate --method, sync-vs-stream decisions in cat/verify/modify

exports.name: ZipCommonOptions
exports.via: commonOptions(args, sink) = { strict, onDiagnostic, limits }

exports.name: ZipCompressionOptions
exports.via: --method/--level/--deterministic and manifest compression

exports.name: ZipDataError
exports.via: mapZipError -> E_DATA with entryName and { expectedCrc, actualCrc }

exports.name: ZipDataErrorCode
exports.via: the 5 data-code rows of ZIP_TO_CLI (all reachable)

exports.name: ZipDiagnostic
exports.via: createDiagnosticSink() -> DiagnosticRow (dedup by code + entryName)

exports.name: ZipDiagnosticCode
exports.via: ZIP_DIAGNOSTIC_CODES, schema diagnostics; every code reachable (raisedBy in errors.json)

exports.name: ZipDiagnosticHandler
exports.via: the sink onDiagnostic

exports.name: ZipEntry
exports.via: rowFromEntry() incl. rawNameHex/commentHex, inspect stats, cat/extract/modify planning

exports.name: ZipError
exports.via: mapZipError() instanceof root; err.code -> zipCode

exports.name: ZipErrorCode
exports.via: ZIP_TO_CLI satisfies Record<ZipErrorCode, ...> compile-time guard (the codes reach the envelope as zipCode)

exports.name: ZipExtraField
exports.via: read: extraFields rows (--long, inspect --extra hex); write: manifest extraFields

exports.name: ZipFormatError
exports.via: mapZipError -> E_PARSE (E_INPUT for the two entry-name codes)

exports.name: ZipFormatErrorCode
exports.via: the 13 format-code rows of ZIP_TO_CLI (all reachable)

exports.name: ZipLimitError
exports.via: mapZipError -> E_LIMIT with { limit, configured, observed }

exports.name: ZipLimitErrorCode
exports.via: the 2 limit-code rows of ZIP_TO_CLI (ZIP_LIMIT_INVALID pre-empted by the CLI)

exports.name: ZipLimits
exports.via: the eight --max-* flags, doctor limits data, schema limits

exports.name: ZipModifier
exports.via: modify: addEntry/replaceEntry/removeEntry/renameEntry/setComment(string | Uint8Array)/save/saveCompact

exports.name: ZipModifierOptions
exports.via: modify --method/--level/--deterministic/--date + common options

exports.name: ZipReader
exports.via: entries, getEntry, readEntryStream/readEntryRaw/readEntry (cat), verifyEntry (modify survivors, verify --entry), entryCount/isZip64/comment (commentHex)/bytes

exports.name: ZipSecurityError
exports.via: mapZipError -> E_SECURITY with entryName

exports.name: ZipSecurityErrorCode
exports.via: the 6 security-code rows of ZIP_TO_CLI (all reachable)

exports.name: ZipUnsupportedError
exports.via: mapZipError -> E_UNSUPPORTED with { feature }

exports.name: ZipUnsupportedErrorCode
exports.via: the 6 unsupported-code rows of ZIP_TO_CLI (ZIP_UNSUPPORTED_ZIP64_STREAMING needs > 4 GiB)

exports.name: ZipUnsupportedFeature
exports.via: detail.feature in the E_UNSUPPORTED envelope

exports.name: ZipVerificationReport
exports.via: the verify report body (error carries { code, message }, no detail)

exports.name: ZipWriter
exports.via: create: add/addDirectory/addStream/toBytes/stream; setComment(Uint8Array) via --comment-file / commentBase64

exports.name: activeDeflateTier
exports.via: tier in create/modify/inflate envelopes; doctor deflate-tier/deflate-pinned (never injected under --parallel)

exports.name: crc32
exports.via: crc32 command (chunked, --seed, --expect)

exports.name: createInflator
exports.via: inflate default resumable path (not affected by setInflateImpl)

exports.name: createZip
exports.via: create (buffered and --stream), batch --task create

exports.name: createZipModifier
exports.via: modify over an eagerly opened reader, survivors verified before save

exports.name: extractZip
exports.via: extract --buffered

exports.name: extractZipStream
exports.via: extract (default)

exports.name: getCodec
exports.via: inflate --method, methodName(), doctor codecs, unsupported/verifiability checks in extract/cat/verify/modify

exports.name: getUnixMode
exports.via: unixMode column (four octal digits), extract --preserve-mode (files)

exports.name: initNodeZipCodecs
exports.via: ensureCodecsReady() in the bridge via prepareEngine() (skipped under --pure-codecs)

exports.name: isSymlinkEntry
exports.via: isSymlink column, inspect --check no-symlinks, extract symlink policy

exports.name: iterateZipEntries
exports.via: stream

exports.name: openZip
exports.via: openArchive(): list, inspect, cat, extract, verify --entry, modify

exports.name: registerCodec
exports.via: --codec <module>: reader for any method AND writer for methods 0/8 (overridesBuiltin, warning, refused by create --parallel)

exports.name: sanitizeEntryPath
exports.via: name pre-checks in create/modify, extract directory entries, every stream name, basis of safeJoin

exports.name: setDeflateImpl
exports.via: --codec deflateImpl: sync deflate tier of create/modify (tier injected) unless --deterministic; refused by create --parallel without --deterministic

exports.name: setInflateImpl
exports.via: --codec inflateImpl: sync/streaming reader paths (cat, extract, verify, modify, inflate --sync); not createInflator nor the stream pump; no doctor row (ROADMAP)

exports.name: verifyZip
exports.via: verify (whole archive), batch --task verify

exports.name: ByteSource
exports.via: the worker subpath re-exports the root declaration; the bridge imports ByteSource from the root entry only

exports.name: ParallelZipOptions
exports.via: create --parallel --workers/--min-job-size/--job-timeout (+ CreateZipOptions); workerUrl bridge-owned by decision

exports.name: ParallelZipWriter
exports.via: the create writer under --parallel (toBytes awaited; stream() under --parallel --stream)

exports.name: StreamOptions
exports.via: the worker subpath re-exports the root declaration; the bridge imports StreamOptions from the root entry only

exports.name: createParallelZip
exports.via: create --parallel via loadParallelZip() (lazy, explicit workerUrl)
